description: Sphere r 1500 resting on the ground at (5000, 600), off the path's axis. +X for 5 s: contact and slide round it.
collision: mixed: box primitives (UBoxComponent), spheres (USphereComponent), convex hulls and triangle meshes (UProceduralMeshComponent, cooked shapes as written)
notes: t and dt are what the test passed to UWorld::Tick; moveDt is the DeltaSeconds PerformMovement used. substeps lists each CalcVelocity (walk) or NewFallVelocity (fall) sub-step time. Input is the world-space vector passed to AddMovementInput before the tick (scale 1).
